listing.tagline: Read scratchpads in the hub and in Kanban panes
listing.description: Opens a scratchpad (a folder with scratchpad.json, made by the scratch CLI) in a Kanban pane or in its own tab, grouped by project. In Kanban, click a linked pad to open it in a pane and Shift+click to open it in the Scratchpads tab. Each config dir keeps its own list of pads. Each pad runs the scratch browser viewer, which stops when no page has shown it for 10 minutes. Needs the scratch CLI on PATH.

screenshots.alt: The Scratchpads home view: the pad list grouped by project, each pad with its description, a bar of its file types and its file count; recent pads as cards, an Open last pad action and a field to open a pad folder by its path
screenshots.title: Home
screenshots.caption: With no pad open: the pads by project, the recent pads, quick actions and a field to open any pad folder.

screenshots.title: In a Kanban pane
screenshots.caption: Click a pad that a session linked, and it opens in a pane beside the board.
